display.purpose: Game module dock/hero titles only — uppercase, loudest text in the system.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, column headers, badges — always uppercase, tracked out.

body.purpose: Stat values, descriptions, list rows — the volume-read layer.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the trading card stage only — the one element that feels physically raised.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Active/selected/CTA state glow at the accent color. Never a resting-state shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover lifts, tile selection, drawer slide — the system's default motion curve.

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Expand/collapse transitions (search box growing, bar fills).

motion.name: shine-sweep
motion.purpose: The one ambient looping animation allowed at rest, reserved for the primary CTA and the trading card's foil. Respects prefers-reduced-motion everywhere it's used.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one CTA style with ambient motion — gold foil gradient, dark ink text, continuous shine sweep.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: #14110a; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #ffe9b0, #FFB11B 55%, #ffe9b0 100%); padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,177,27,0.35), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5) inset; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,177,27,0.5), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5) inset; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -60%; left: -30%; width: 40%; height: 220%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transform: rotate(20deg); animation: dsShineSweep 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsShineSweep { 0%, 30% { left: -30%; } 70%, 100% { left: 130%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No resting box — background and color only appear on hover or when holding a value (.active).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: #8a8a8a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #e5e5e5; } .ds-btn-ghost.active { color: #FFB11B; } .ds-btn-ghost.active:hover { background: rgba(255,177,27,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFB11B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Select
components.description: Invisible until hover/focus; gold text signals a non-default value is selected.
components.css: .ds-select-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-select-wrap::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 7px; top: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-right: 1.5px solid #3a3a3a; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #3a3a3a; transform: translateY(-65%) rotate(45deg); pointer-events: none; } .ds-select { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #e5e5e5; font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 22px 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-select:hover, .ds-select:focus { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-select.accent { color: #FFB11B; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Trading Card
components.description: The signature component: cut-corner notch, always-on holo stripe, skewed foil rating badge. Every other surface is a quieter descendant of this.
components.html:
#1294
J. Tatum
components.css: .ds-card { width: 220px; position: relative; border-radius: 17px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #17151b 0%, #0c0b0e 55%, #14100a 100%); border: 1px solid #262626; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 22px), calc(100% - 22px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-card-holo { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; opacity: 0.16; background: repeating-linear-gradient(72deg, transparent 0 6px, #FFB11B 6px 8px, transparent 8px 16px, #fff 16px 17px, transparent 17px 26px); } .ds-card-top { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 14px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-card-rank { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFB11B; } .ds-card-rating { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #14110a; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #ffe9b0, #FFB11B 55%, #ffe9b0 100%); padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 3px; transform: skewX(-8deg); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,177,27,0.4), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5) inset; } .ds-card-name { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 10px 14px 14px; font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #e5e5e5; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The game module's base surface — same gradient/bevel language as the trading card, quieter, no notch.
components.html:
Draft Process
Pick nine players across any era.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; padding: 15px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #17151b 0%, #0c0b0e 55%, #14100a 100%); border: 1px solid #262626; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8b857e; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-panel-label::before { content: ''; width: 14px; height: 1px; background: #FFB11B; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #b4afa8; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: Primary Arch is a scout's binder of graded player cards, not a stats terminal and not an arcade. A binder has two states, and both are correct: most of the time you're flipping fast through quiet reference pages — dense rows, muted ink, no ceremony, built for a scout who reads a hundred lines a minute. Then you pull one card out to look at it properly, and it's a real object — foil, holo stripe, a bevel of light tracing the cut corner, a rating badge that catches the light. The binder metaphor is what makes both states belong to the same object instead of reading as two different apps: the card is always the same card, only the light changes.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, two energy levels — see The One Root Rule.
The trading card (holo, foil, cut corner, rating badge) is the signature object; every other surface is the same card face flattened out.
Dark-committed, not dark-mode-as-default — no light variant exists.
Ghost-until-interaction inputs: visibility is a state signal, not a permanent frame.

rules.name: The One Root Rule
rules.body: There is one color system, not two. Game surfaces re-declare a brighter text scale than data surfaces because a large glass card face needs it — never brighten data to match game, or dim game to match data.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only color that glows, animates, or gets a shine sweep. Pitch Teal gets full parity everywhere else but never shimmers.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Means-Game Rule
rules.body: Loud, tracked-out uppercase Rajdhani signals the game module. Data-page headlines stay sentence case even at bold weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow just for existing. Reserved for the trading card itself and actively-glowing accent states.

rules.name: The One Notch Rule
rules.body: The cut-corner silhouette belongs to the trading card alone — reusing it elsewhere blurs the one shape a user should always recognize as 'that's a player.'

rules.name: The Ghost-Until-Earned Rule
rules.body: Inputs with nothing to say (empty, unfocused, default) should be nearly invisible. Visibility is a signal the user has done something.

dos: Do keep the trading card's cut-corner + holo + foil vocabulary exclusive to the card itself.
Do let game surfaces run brighter/louder than data surfaces — deliberate, not drift.
Do keep inputs invisible until they have something to say.
Do use var(--accent) for sport-conditional color and var(--yamabuki) only for always-gold elements.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every ambient/looping animation.
donts: Don't use gradient-clipped text anywhere, including for signature headings.
Don't put a resting box-shadow on anything but the trading card or an actively-glowing accent state.
Don't give a second color the gold accent's shine-sweep/glow treatment.
Don't brighten the data register's ink-faint to match the game module's, or dim the game module's to match data.
Don't reach for rounded-lg/generic Tailwind defaults, raw palette classes, or a thick single-side accent border as a substitute for the system's own tokens.
